verdicts.q: 'Ambaji Mohanthal', a temple prasad that received a GI tag in October 2026, belongs to which state?
verdicts.note: GI grant date is reported inconsistently (8 Oct vs 11 Oct, when the certificate was handed over); the explanation's precise '8 October' is not reliable. Key (Gujarat) confirmed.

fix.explanation: Ambaji Mohanthal, the besan-based prasad of the Ambaji Temple in Banaskantha district, Gujarat, received the GI tag in October 2026 under Class 30 (foodstuffs/sweets); the applicant was the Shree Arasuri Ambaji Mata Devasthan Trust. A GI registration is valid for 10 years and can be renewed. Source: Manorama Yearbook, 13 Oct 2026; Adda247, Oct 2026.

verdicts.q: Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve is located in which state?

fix.explanation: Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve, in Chamoli (with parts of Pithoragarh and Bageshwar) districts of Uttarakhand, was declared in January 1988 and joined UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves in 2004. Nanda Devi National Park (1982) and Valley of Flowers National Park together form a UNESCO World Heritage Site (1988, extended 2005). Source: Lok Sabha answer (eparlib); UNESCO.

verdicts.q: Bishkek, which hosted the SCO Summit on 31 August-1 September 2026, is the capital of which country?

fix.q: Bishkek, which hosted the 26th SCO Summit (Council of Heads of State) in September 2026, is the capital of which country?
fix.explanation: Bishkek is the capital of Kyrgyzstan; its currency is the som. The 26th SCO Council of Heads of State met there on 1 September 2026, and Pakistan took over the rotating SCO chairmanship. The 2025 SCO summit was in Tianjin, China. Source: SCO Secretariat / GKToday, 1 Sep 2026.
